results.title: Now is the time to put on your glasses
results.creator_credit: Norman McLaren, Evelyn Lambart and ONF | NFB
results.brief_description: The right eye print of a 3-D films commissioned by the British Film Institute for the Festival of Britain. Photographed paper cutouts and images drawn directly on film stock were given single-frame animation. Stereoscopy was achieved by photographing and drawing two visuals (one for the left eye, one for the right eye) with controlled displacement of the elements in relationship to each other. The hand-drawn sound was also composed and recorded on two separate bands for stereoscopic playing. (Award: Toronto.)

results.title: Now generation
results.creator_credit: Eric Fullilove, Andrew J. Helgeson, Austral Pacific Productions and National Bank of Australia
results.brief_description: To be involved with banking is to be involved with people. This is the underlying message on modern career opportunities in one of Australia’s major trading banks. All levels of staff activities are shown in metropolitan, rural and overseas branches. A useful career guide for school leavers.

results.title: Now flow the rivers westward
results.creator_credit: H Malcolm and Snowy Mountains Authority
results.brief_description: The development of the Snowy Mountains Scheme, through the eyes of an English air pilot who comes to work there. Sketches the history of the Scheme, and describes in more detail the building of the Tumut Pond Dam, and the vast underground T1 power station. Shows the variety of activities within the Scheme and several shots of the country from the air.

results.title: Notes on the Port of St. Francis
results.brief_description: A cinematic “poem” that straddles documentary and experimental traditions capturing the atmosphere of San Francisco. Shows fresh and unexpected scenes of the city and its people in addition to San Francisco’s landmarks. The narration, spoken by Vincent Price, is taken from a descriptive essay on San Francisco written in 1882 by Robert Louis Stevenson.

results.title: Notes on the passage of time
results.brief_description: A three colour separation study filmed at Pearl Beach, which examines the same scene of Amethyst Avenue during the progression of a winter, then a summer day. With the sea in the background, the moving objects such as the pedestrians, cyclists, traffic are transparent and ephemeral while the stationary objects are opaque and retain a permanent quality. A strange, almost surreal quality illustrating the transitional nature of life.

results.title: Notes on a triangle
results.brief_description: In this short animation film the triangle achieves the distinction of principal dancer in a geometric ballet. The triangle is shown splitting into some three hundred transformations, dividing and sub-dividing with grace and symmetry to the music of a waltz. The film’s artist and animator is Rene Jodoin, whose credits include Dance Squared and several collaborations with Norman McLaren. Film without words.
